15. | ORDINANCE~2™! READING — Amending certain Sections of Chapter 13.20, Wastewater
Treatment and Disposal of Title 13, Public Services of the Municipal Code of the City of
Cheyenne, Wyoming, regarding wastewater treatment and disposal. (SPONSOR ~ DR.
RINNE)

Dr. Rinne moved to approve on 2" reading, seconded by Mr. Laybourn. Motion carried by
unanimous voice vote.

Nate Kaufhold, Board of Public Utilities, provided a staff report and committee member Segrave
commented on the item.

21. RESOLUTION — Authorizing the Mayor and the City Clerk to sign a Final Plat for Shining
D North at Sweetgrass, a replat of all of Block 15 (Lot 1 thru 8 inclusive), and Open Space
Tract AA, and all of Lot 1, Block 16, Sweetgrass, 7" Filing, and a portion of adjacent
rights-of-way, City of Cheyenne, Laramie County, Wyoming (located east of Sweetgrass
Drive and south of E College Drive.). (SPONSOR ~ MR. COOK)

Dr. Rinne moved to adopt, seconded by Mr. Laybourn. Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.

Connor White, Planning & Development Department, provided a staff report and Casey Palma,
Palma Land Planning, was available for questions. Chairman Cook and committee member Rinne
commented on the item.

22. RESOLUTION ~ Authorizing the Mayor and the City Clerk to sign a Final Plat for R and
R at Sweetgrass, a replat of all of Lots 1, 2, & 3, and Tract T, Block 8, Sweetgrass, 2"
Filing, and a portion of adjacent rights-of-way, City of Cheyenne, Laramie County,
Wyoming (located southeast of the intersection of Sweetgrass Drive and E College Drive.).
(SPONSOR - MR. COOK)

Mr. Laybourn moved to adopt, seconded by Dr. Rinne. Mr. Segrave moved to amend by substitute
‘map dated September 11, 2023, seconded by Dr. Rinne, Motion to amend carried by unanimous
voice vote. Main motion, as amended, carried by unanimous voice vote.

Connor White, Planning & Development Department, provided a staff report and Casey Palma,
Palma Land Planning, provided additional information. Committee member Rinne commented on
the item.
